world.axes: game x right, game y toward the player (down the screen), z up. Blender X = x, Blender Y = -y, Blender Z = z.

camera.screen: sx = x * ppu, sy = (y * sin(elevation) - z * cos(elevation)) * ppu; ground (z = 0) inverts exactly: x = sx / ppu, y = sy / (ppu * sin(elevation))
camera.sprites: unit sprites are billboards rendered at sprite_elevation_deg (so faces and weapons read) and drawn unit_scale times true size (readability on a phone; collision stays true size) with their feet anchor on the ground projection; props, obstacles and keeps render at elevation_deg so their footprints sit exactly on their collision circles; everything above the ground sorts back to front by y

light.rule: every light vector has Blender X = 0 (symmetric about the camera plane) so mirrored facings stay correctly lit

atlas.anchor: feet: the ground contact point of the body centre, stored per frame in the atlas json

arena.ground: base/public/arena/<act>/ground.webp, the flat ground only (no tall props), covers the board plus margins at the contract camera
arena.props: base/public/arena/<act>/props.webp atlas + props.json: tall props and obstacles as depth-sorted sprites with a ground anchor and a collision radius
arena.keep: base/public/arena/keep/<state>.webp, states 100, 66, 33, 0 per team via mask

vfx.sheets: base/public/vfx/<name>.webp + <name>.json, square frames, frame count and fps per sheet
vfx.blend: the active style picks additive or normal for glows (style.vfx.blend)
